authorization: user delegated independent business experiment decisions; on 2026-08-31 requested offline continuation while avoiding vLLM
question: Does source-scoped method presentation reduce the cost or regressions of content-only historical memory without harming the no-memory anchor?
scope: new local research protocol, not old Skill Gate, not Promotion, not a claim of new Agent capability

excluded.24-23: worksheet dimensions exceed the unchanged preflight bound
excluded.146-49: reserve not selected; broader string-matching ability not required for this scope hypothesis
excluded.80-42: reserve not selected; large multi-sheet consolidation would add a distinct scaling variable

selection_basis: task instructions and structural preflight only, before any model run on these tasks; explicit source/target, bounded value oracle, formula-free input/reference
data_caveat: public benchmark may be in model training; confirmation means not used for this project's policy refinement, not model-unseen; example sheets inside original fixtures remain unchanged
delivery_suffix: Preserve all data and formatting outside the requested transformation. Stop after verifying the saved output. Use literal computed values, not new Excel formulas, because this host does not provide formula recalculation.

recall.query: spreadsheet Excel openpyxl workbook rows columns
recall.scope: same isolated source team/user/agent; no transfer task or session filter
recall.frequency: once per memory-arm session, immutable cached block thereafter
recall.compare: CONTENT_ONLY and SOURCE_SCOPED must receive identical retrieved record IDs/order/content/background before rendering

policy_delta: v2 selects work_method records with source task/background, preserves source context and treats fixed source details as conditional; v1 keeps all recalled content. This is one bundled policy intervention, not isolated attribution to each component.
oracle: unchanged workbook_oracle.py target-cell values; whole-workbook values and formatting remain separate audits
freeze: design hashes now; runtime/images/sessions/identity/fixtures/recall rows must be frozen and admitted before the first real call

outcome_rules.infra: any arm with missing execution/usage/recall evidence is incomparable; retain main and do not count as a task success or a fix
outcome_rules.quality: v2 has no newly_broken task relative to NONE or CONTENT_ONLY_V1, including every valid diagnostic task
outcome_rules.benefit: v2 newly_fixes at least one CONTENT_ONLY_V1 failure, OR aggregate v2 tokens <= 0.90 times CONTENT_ONLY_V1 with no worse task success count
outcome_rules.cost: aggregate v2 tokens/tool/model calls each <= 1.20 times NONE and CONTENT_ONLY_V1
outcome_rules.confirmation_admission: only when all diagnostic arms are comparable and quality, benefit and cost hold; otherwise stop real calls and report negative/inconclusive evidence
outcome_rules.confirmation: run the two reserved tasks once per arm with the same frozen policy; no newly_broken relative to either control and the combined six-task quality/benefit/cost rules must hold for a tentative policy signal
outcome_rules.probes: none in this revision; no best-of or discretionary retries
outcome_rules.promotion: DISABLED; even a tentative policy signal is not Skill Promotion or production deployment

stop_conditions: implementation bug: retain attempt and fix under a new runtime revision
frozen policy/data/budget change: never continue as the same attempt
diagnostic admission not met: do not run reserved confirmation
execution_state: REAL_RUN_DEFERRED_VLLM_AVOIDED; no connectivity checks or model calls in offline preparation
